versions.changelog: Restructured: English section + Chinese section (separate mono-lingual halves)
Bilingual SKILL.md; English model names; Sana default confirmed
更新默认模型为Sana（Pollinations.ai模型升级），新增seed参数支持，更新模型选择表，调整生成时间估算

- Initial release of the free text-to-image generation tool.
- No API Key required; uses the Pollinations.ai free API.
- Supports customizable styles, sizes, and models (default, flux, turbo, dreamshaper).
- Accepts both Chinese and English prompts.
- Returns generated image directly to users.
- Some usage limits: free API queue, best results in English, non-commercial use only.
